hero.subtitle: Stop guessing. Get real-time, actionable insights on every click, scan, and tap across all your channels — from a single, powerful dashboard. With Dragolink Analytics, your marketing becomes highly predictable and perfectly measurable.
bulletPoints: Real-time click data with zero lag across our edge network
Geographic & device breakdown by country and city
Custom UTM parameters and automated campaign filters
Exportable CSV reports for any date range with one click

features.title: Geographic Data
features.description: Know exactly where your audience is located — down to the city level. Optimize localized campaigns with high-fidelity heat maps across 190+ countries.

features.title: Device & Browser
features.description: Understand how users access your content. Track operating systems, device types (mobile, tablet, desktop), screen resolutions, and browser versions in real time.

features.title: Referrer Tracking
features.description: Identify your best performing channels instantly. See exactly which social networks, emails, paid ads, or organic search terms are driving the most traffic.

features.title: Time-based Insights
features.description: Discover peak engagement hours by timezone. Schedule campaigns at exactly the right time for maximum reach, open rates, and conversion.

features.title: Conversion Funnels
features.description: Track click-to-conversion paths across multiple links and complex marketing campaigns. Understand your full funnel, not just individual isolated clicks.

features.title: Custom UTM Builder
features.description: Automatically append UTM parameters to every link. Filter and segment analytics data by source, medium, campaign, content, and custom tags.
